name: Flood
description: Rising water from heavy rain, overflowing rivers or storm surge.

name: Typhoon
description: Tropical cyclone with strong winds and heavy rain.

name: Earthquake
description: Ground shaking, possible aftershocks and tsunami along the coast.

name: Volcanic Activity
description: Ashfall, volcanic gas or eruption (e.g. Taal Volcano).

name: Other Emergency
description: Any other emergency not listed above.
